question: Hold final acceptance pending live host evidence and resolution of the failed ShellCheck gate?

artifacts.summary: Both independent reviewers approve candidate c9cbd198 static implementation; nine hermetic tests and smoke passed. Recommend hold: AC-1 through AC-5 live evidence is incomplete and repository ShellCheck remains failed on an unchanged fixture. Proposed live scope is four host sessions and at most six Jev requests using synthetic evidence; pricing and an explicit dollar ceiling must be established before requesting paid-run approval. No delivery or paid-run authority is requested by this hold decision.
